rationale: X has a distinctive serif headline, an arched sunrise illustration with a timetable card, bespoke per-class illustrations and a confident terracotta, forest and cream palette, so it reads as a designed brand. Y has a strong, specific timetable UI and a studio-map visual, but its sage, cream and brown palette, sans headings and generic card grid feel more like a standard SaaS template, and the hero leaves dead space below the fold. X is the one a design director would ship.
